author: IGN
description:
In celebration of its 10th anniversary, the globally beloved film YOUR NAME is coming to North American theatres nationwide in a new 4K remaster beginning August 14 in both its original Japanese language and English dub. GKIDS, the Academy Award-winning producer and distributor of acclaimed and artist-driven animation from around the world, also debuted a new trailer ahead of its theatrical release.

The 2016 feature is an original anime film, directed and written by Makoto Shinkai (Suzume, Weathering with You) and animated by CoMix Wave Films. Upon its original release, it swiftly became a global phenomenon, and went on to receive global critical acclaim, awards, and accolades, including winning 2016 Sitges - Catalonian International Film Festival’s “Best Animated Feature Film”; 2017 Awards of the Japanese Academy “Best Animation”, “Best Screenplay”, “Best Director” and “Best Music Score”; 2016 Los Angeles Film Critics Association Awards “Best Animation”, and more. title: Your Name: Exclusive 10th Anniversary 4K Re-Release Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Ancient. Immortal. Unstoppable. Get a deep dive into the gameplay of the Necron faction in this latest Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 trailer for the upcoming real-time strategy game. Witness the return of the Necrons as they restore their tombs, expand their domain to earn their Dominion resource across Kronus, and awaken ancient engines of war. 

As the Necron reclaim Kronus, they expand their domain to earn resources across the battlefield by restoring ancient structures and activating their Power Matrix, steadily turning the war in their favor. At the center of their growing empire stands the Tomb Citadel, which also serves as the production engine for your units. 

Leading their forces are two powerful commanders: the Chronomancer Thothmek, who bends time to disrupt enemies and accelerate Necron reanimation, and Ahmnok, once ruler of Kronus, consumed entirely by the urge to annihilate all life. 

With self-repairing legions, unyielding constructs, and ancient technologies that b
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official Necron Faction Overview Trailer

Satisfactory: The Board Game is a 1-4 player competitive, sandbox tabletop experience adapted from the logistics game. Compete with your fellow FICSIT Pioneers to extract the natural resources of MASSAGE-2(A-B)b and be the first to finish the Space Elevator to save humanity and, of course, become Employee of the Month. Crowdfunding for Satisfactory: The Board Game begins in September 2026.

#IGN #Gaming

description:
Enjoy this red band preview from the third installment of the cult comedy classic from the Broken Lizard crew: Super Troopers 3. When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

Jay Chandrasekhar directs Super Troopers 3 and stars alongside Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter, Erik Stolhanske, Brian Cox, Marisa Coughlan, Nat Faxon, Chace Crawford, Andrew Dismukes, Hannah Simone, Iqbal Theba, Sakina Jaffrey, Jon Rudnitsky, and Lisa Gilroy.

description:
Join co-founder and executive producer Jean-Francois Boivin from developer Panache Digital Games for a closer look at 1666: Amsterdam in this new video for the upcoming third-person action-adventure game. Meet the dual protagonists of 1666: Amsterdam, as Boivin dives into the background of these two characters: Noa and Aaron. We learn about Noa's mystical tools and Aaron's perspective in his new form. 1666: Amsterdam will be available on PC. The prologue is available to play now on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

#ign #gaming
title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Dual Protagonists: Gameplay Feature Video #2

author: IGN
description:
Join the development team at Limbic Entertainment for a closer look at gameplay and more from Corsair Cove in this latest trailer for the upcoming pirate-themed city-builder game. In this new, exclusive 15-minute video of developer-narrated gameplay, take a tour of the Ship Graveyard island and Devil's Basin island. Learn about the challenges these islands bring as you work to build your pirate base, including environmental challenges, resource management, raiding, resource distribution, and much more. Corsair Cove will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC on July 31, 2026.

In Corsair Cove, build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

#ign #gaming
title: Corsair Cove - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, and Epic Games Store. author: IGN
description: Silent Hill: Townfall being in first-person definitely sparked the thought of what P.T. could have been, because my time with Townfall showed that the more intimate interaction with the environment can bring you closer to both the story it's trying to tell and the gameplay elements that give rise to such dread. I came in thinking it would be just another direction the series could explore, and came away eager for whatever comes after the end of my preview demo.
title: Silent Hill: Townfall Might Be Exactly What the Series Needs | IGN Preview
